durableFields.notes: Existing condition lifecycle state owns Blinded, Restrained, Incapacitated, Prone, and Unconscious outcomes for save-gated and repeat-save condition spells.
Existing active effects own spell condition duration, Sleep pending repeat-save and Unconscious effects, and repeat-save cleanup state.
Existing Concentration state owns concentrating caster cleanup when a repeat-save condition spell ends.
Route events are derived from owner-local End Turn repeat-save hole ids and condition/active-effect/Concentration state deltas; no route event or pending-hole cache is stored in BattleState.
Existing save-gated spell route projection owns action-economy discovery and Saving Throw outcome fill order for Color Spray and Entangle selected-identity branches.

notes: Task 9 introduced no new durable BattleState or BattleCreatureState fields.

The new repeatSaveConditionEffect route projection is derived from existing owner hole-id projections and state deltas, not selected spell id, authored name, QNT action name, connector filename, or a duplicate route-local state cache.
Condition-choice catalog identity remains a support-profile admission/input boundary and is not stored as production reducer dispatch state.
